chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abi al-Maghra', from Abi Baseer, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Ali (peace be upon him) used to flog the free man and the slave, the Jew and the Christian, regarding wine, with eighty (lashes).

key_terms.الْحُرَّ: the free man (as opposed to a slave)
key_terms.يَجْلِدُ: to flog or strike with a whip

ai.seo_question: What is the fixed penalty for drinking wine according to Imam Ali (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi, transmitted through the chain of Abu Basir to Imam al-Sadiq, confirms the standard hadd of eighty lashes for wine consumption, a ruling derived from the Quranic verse 24:2. By explicitly listing free men, slaves, Jews, and Christians, the Imam emphasizes the universality of this penalty across different social strata and religious communities (dhimmis) within the Islamic legal framework. This establishes that the hadd is a fixed divine punishment rather than a discretionary one, reinforcing its application regardless of the individual's status or faith.
